title: El Salvador and Honduras today: security, money and elections
goal: Describe, with dates and sources, what happened recently in El Salvador and Honduras, using the passive with ser.

sections.title: El Salvador and Honduras today: security, money and elections
body: In this lesson you read about recent events in El Salvador and Honduras: the state of exception, bitcoin and the 2025 election. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English. The facts are dated and attributed.
The grammar is the one you know for saying what was done without making the doer the subject: *fue aprobado*, *fueron detenidas*.

items: I can say what was approved, declared or announced, with *ser* + past participle.
I can name who says what about recent events in El Salvador and Honduras.
I can give the date of an event with the passive.
